sections.title: Item 7. MD&A
sections.content:
ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

In 2023, ad impressions delivered across our Family of Apps increased by 28% year-over-year. Reality Labs expenses were $17.97 billion, resulting in an operating loss of $(16,120) million.

sections.title: Item 8. Financial Statements
sections.content:

| --- | --- | --- |
| Family of Apps revenue | $ 133,015 | $ 114,450 |
| Reality Labs revenue | $ 1,896 | $ 2,159 |
| Total revenue | $ 134,902 | $ 116,609 |
| Reality Labs operating loss | $ (16,120) | $ (13,717) |
| Net income | $ 39,098 | $ 23,200 |
